notes: Sepolia only (chainId 11155111); chain selection belongs to deployment policy and is not enforced by these constructors. LaunchToken is the accepted GOTCHI ERC20 with no constructor arguments, admin, post-deployment mint or transfer fee. All listed application constructors are nonpayable and use address arguments. Policy $owner supplies MockAavegotchi's immutable MINTER and FlipEscrow's immutable OPERATOR; the minter creates mock NFTs and the operator queues commit-reveal commitments. The operator chooses the secrets, so in this mock it can grind or withhold them and is trusted for flip fairness, not only liveness. Other application modules have no admin withdrawal or upgrade role. GotchiFeeHook takes only the literal Sepolia PoolManager. FeeSink follows it immediately and binds itself once from its constructor; atomic factory deployment prevents interception of the public first binding. Other sibling references are constructor immutables; no initialization calls are included. The manifest pool uses the allowed 3000 fee tier, native ETH, tick spacing 60 and decimal sqrtPriceX96 2^96. The factory supplies its initialization-only guard, LP and MerkleDistributor. GotchiStackDeployer in src/ is a script-path helper whose DEPLOYER is its creator; a factory deploying the hook and FeeSink together obtains the same atomicity, so it is deliberately not listed. That guarded pool has no GotchiFeeHook swap callbacks. ForeverLiquidity defines a separate ETH/GOTCHI pool with LP_FEE=0, tick spacing 60 and GotchiFeeHook; the zero LP fee is a source constant, not this manifest's pool fee. Application constructors neither initialize nor fund that separate pool; anyone may initialize it afterwards through ForeverLiquidity.initializePool and lock liquidity, and this manifest cannot configure its opening liquidity or mcap. A usable GotchiFeeHook address must have low 14 bits 0x00cc for beforeSwap, afterSwap and both return-delta permissions; salt selection and validation are deployment prerequisites outside this schema. There is no beforeInitialize gate. In a correctly configured hook pool, FEE_BPS=30 skims ETH through PoolManager.take into FeeSink. At MIN_BUY_THRESHOLD=0.01 ether, permissionless nonReentrant triggerBuy buys the cheapest MockBaazaar listing for FlipEscrow and reverts when that listing costs more than the balance or more than the MAX_BUY_PRICE=0.1 ether constant; collection alone does not trigger a purchase. Sellers withdraw credited proceeds. The mock flip uses FLIP_BURN_BPS=5000 with BURN_ADDRESS=0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD; missing or withheld reveals can time out to burn, and no eligible winner also burns. Picker participation is opt-in and custodial: a holder's weight is the GOTCHI they deposit into HolderWeightedPicker and have not withdrawn, checkpointed per block; FlipEscrow resolves each flip with pickAt against the end of the block before the flip request, with no live balance read, so later deposits, withdrawals or transfers cannot change the winner. Zero weights, zero/dead addresses, PoolManager and the picker itself are excluded; the picker has no admin. Accepted sources emit the requested fee, listing, purchase, flip, burn and airdrop events; README.md documents roles, operation and mock-randomness limitations, and abi/ contains the exported ABIs. Base, Diamond/live Baazaar, real Aavegotchi NFTs and VRF migration remain README TODOs only.
